description: This JavaScript file contains various front-end functionalities for an OpenCart e-commerce platform, including tooltip initialization, observing DOM mutations, button state management, form submissions via AJAX, file uploads, autocomplete feature, toggle product views (list/grid), and modal dialogs.

methods.name: oc_tooltip
methods.description: Initializes and shows Bootstrap tooltips on elements with data-bs-toggle='tooltip'.

methods.name: $.fn.observe
methods.description: Sets up MutationObserver on selected elements to observe DOM changes.

methods.name: $.fn.button
methods.description: Controls button states, such as 'loading' and 'reset', changing the button's appearance and disabled state.

methods.name: $.fn.autocomplete
methods.description: Enables autocomplete functionality on input fields with dynamic suggestion lists.
